endpoints.type:
@Forward.denote_while_least
     : forall (S P : Type) (MN MF : Type -> Type) (FI : Measure.SemanticMeasure MF)
         (MX : Mixed.MixedMeasure MN MF) (FO : @Omega.SemanticOmega MF FI)
         (Ord : @Omega.SemanticMeasureOrderLaws MF FI FO),
       @Omega.SemanticOmegaLaws MF FI FO ->
       @Omega.SemanticOmegaCofinalityLaws MF FI FO ->
       forall (Select : @Omega.SemanticOmegaSelection MF FI FO) (coin : P -> MN bool),
       @Omega.SemanticMeasureDiagonalLaws MF FI FO ->
       forall (b : S -> bool) (c : Syntax.command S P),
       (forall (chain : nat -> MF S) (out : MF S),
        @Omega.sem_lub MF FI FO S chain out ->
        forall n : nat, @Omega.sem_le MF FI FO S (chain n) out) ->
       (forall (chain : nat -> MF S) (out bound : MF S),
        @Omega.sem_lub MF FI FO S chain out ->
        (forall n : nat, @Omega.sem_le MF FI FO S (chain n) bound) ->
        @Omega.sem_le MF FI FO S out bound) ->
       (forall s : S,
        @Omega.sem_le MF FI FO S
          (@KleisliIteration.sem_iter_step MF FI S S
             (@Forward.while_kernel S MF FI b
                (@Forward.denote S P MN MF FI MX FO Ord Select coin c))
             (@Forward.denote S P MN MF FI MX FO Ord Select coin (@Syntax.CWhile S P b c)) s)
          (@Forward.denote S P MN MF FI MX FO Ord Select coin (@Syntax.CWhile S P b c) s) /\
        @Omega.sem_le MF FI FO S
          (@Forward.denote S P MN MF FI MX FO Ord Select coin (@Syntax.CWhile S P b c) s)
          (@KleisliIteration.sem_iter_step MF FI S S
             (@Forward.while_kernel S MF FI b
                (@Forward.denote S P MN MF FI MX FO Ord Select coin c))
             (@Forward.denote S P MN MF FI MX FO Ord Select coin (@Syntax.CWhile S P b c)) s)) /\
       (forall Y : S -> MF S,
        (forall s : S,
         @Omega.sem_le MF FI FO S
           (@KleisliIteration.sem_iter_step MF FI S S
              (@Forward.while_kernel S MF FI b
                 (@Forward.denote S P MN MF FI MX FO Ord Select coin c)) Y s)
           (Y s)) ->
        forall s : S,
        @Omega.sem_le MF FI FO S
          (@Forward.denote S P MN MF FI MX FO Ord Select coin (@Syntax.CWhile S P b c) s)
          (Y s))
